name: skill-atlas
description: Skill Atlas: every SKILL.md in a repository, in the terminal.

scripts.test:ui:docker: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -v /work/node_modules -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.1-noble sh -c 'npm ci && npx playwright test'
scripts.test:ui:update: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -v /work/node_modules -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.1-noble sh -c 'npm ci && npx playwright test --update-snapshots'
